name: carenav-florida
description: CareNav Florida - Multi-Agent Elder Care Navigation System for Florida Medicaid, VA Benefits, and Facility Selection

servers.name: medicaid
servers.description: Florida Medicaid ICP eligibility and spend-down calculations

tools.name: check_medicaid_eligibility
tools.description: Check Florida Medicaid ICP eligibility based on assets, income, and marital status. Returns eligibility status, spend-down amount if needed, and relevant rules.

assets.description: Total countable assets in dollars (excludes home, one vehicle, burial plots)

tools.name: get_medicaid_rules
tools.description: Get current Florida Medicaid ICP rules and limits for the specified year

year.description: Year for rules (defaults to current year)

tools.name: calculate_spend_down
tools.description: Calculate spend-down amount and suggest legal strategies to reach Medicaid eligibility

target_limit.description: Target asset limit (defaults to $2,000 for single)

patient_needs.description: List of patient needs that could justify spend-down (e.g., 'wheelchair', 'home_modification')

tools.name: check_look_back_violations
tools.description: Check for potential Medicaid look-back period violations from asset transfers

transfers.description: List of asset transfers in the past 5 years

servers.name: va_benefits
servers.description: VA Aid & Attendance eligibility and benefit calculations

tools.name: check_va_eligibility
tools.description: Check VA Aid & Attendance eligibility for veteran or surviving spouse

is_spouse_of_veteran.description: Is the patient a spouse/surviving spouse of a veteran?

wartime_service.description: Did the veteran serve during a wartime period?

veteran_deceased.description: Is the veteran deceased? (for surviving spouse benefits)

service_connected_disability.description: Does the veteran have a service-connected disability?

tools.name: calculate_va_benefit
tools.description: Calculate the maximum VA Aid & Attendance benefit amount

tools.name: get_required_documents
tools.description: Get list of required documents for VA Aid & Attendance application

has_dd214.description: Does the applicant already have the DD-214?

servers.name: facility_search
servers.description: Search and compare Florida care facilities (AL, MC, SNF)

tools.name: search_facilities
tools.description: Search for care facilities in Florida matching specified criteria

care_level.description: Care level: AL=Assisted Living, MC=Memory Care, SNF=Skilled Nursing

max_distance_miles.description: Maximum distance from ZIP code in miles

facility_ids.description: List of facility IDs to compare

tools.name: check_admission_requirements
tools.description: Check if a patient meets a facility's admission requirements

servers.name: document_rag
servers.description: RAG-based search over patient documents (medical records, financial statements, etc.)

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Search patient documents using semantic similarity

patient_id.description: Patient ID to search documents for

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Retrieve a specific document by ID

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: List all documents for a patient

tools.name: summarize_documents
tools.description: Generate a summary of documents matching a query

focus_areas.description: Specific areas to focus summary on

prompts.name: carenav_system
prompts.description: System prompt for CareNav Florida assistant
prompts.content:
You are CareNav Florida, an AI assistant helping families navigate elder care decisions in Florida. You have access to specialized tools for checking Medicaid eligibility, VA benefits, searching care facilities, and reviewing patient documents.

Always:
1. Be empathetic - families are going through a difficult time
2. Be specific - provide exact dollar amounts, dates, and action items
3. Be accurate - use the tools to verify information rather than guessing
4. Be compliant - include appropriate disclaimers that this is not legal or financial advice

When helping a family:
1. First understand their complete situation (patient needs, finances, veteran status)
2. Check eligibility for all applicable programs (Medicaid, VA, Medicare)
3. Search for appropriate facilities if needed
4. Provide a clear action plan with prioritized next steps
